staging.hold_reason: WP-373 adds 0089: it schedules the lease sweeper that 0082 defined but never wired up. Paired with the client's new 60s heartbeat, a live run keeps its lease while it runs and a crashed device's run is closed within a minute instead of staying 'running' forever. Schema is unchanged - the migration only creates one pg_cron job. Staging applies first so production repeats a proven step.

backup_waiver.reason: Free plan project has no daily backup and no PITR; owner accepted production apply with no rollback path.

production.hold_reason: OPEN FOR 0089 APPLY (owner standing authorisation). Staging applied 0089 successfully in run 30303743005 with a post-check head of 0089, so production repeats a proven step. This gate is reclosed immediately after the apply. Production remains at 0088. Context: a production query on 2026-07-27 sealed the diagnosis that multi-device timer sync never worked at all - public.global_timer_commands returned 0 rows and notification_outbox held 0 timer_sync rows, meaning not one command ever reached the server since WP-341. Root cause 1: the client emitted origin values ('dart_app', 'native_widget', 'native_notification') that apply_global_timer_command rejects, so every start raised invalid_global_timer_origin, the client swallowed it, and the transaction rolled back without even an audit row. Root cause 2: the in-app stop path (ACTION_STOP_SILENT) produced no V2 stop envelope at all, and the notification/widget stop produced one without expected_run_revision, which the server refuses. WP-373 fixes both on the client and adds 0089 for the sweeper. 0089 changes no table, column, index, policy or grant and inserts no row; it only schedules 'select public.expire_global_timer_v2_leases(200)' every minute. Rollback is a single cron.unschedule, which restores the pre-0089 behaviour with no client release. The backup waiver stays recorded because the project still has no PITR or daily backup - it is not a standing approval to apply. Carried-forward limit: timer sync still covers Android stopwatch/work only - Pomodoro, countdown and Windows produce no V2 commands.
